label: scam
title: Grandson in jail, bail via gift cards

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've been in an accident. I got arrested. Please don't tell Mom, she'll be furious.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh my god, are you okay? What happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay but I need help right now. The lawyer says I can post bond if you send $4,000 today.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Okay, okay, how do I do that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Go to the store and buy four $1,000 Apple gift cards, then read me the codes on the back. Don't tell anyone, it could hurt my case.
